sloka: यदि गुप्ताः प्रजाः सम्यक्तदा सत्यं वचो ऽस्तु मे ।। ७.१९.२९ ॥
transliteration: yadi guptāḥ prajāḥ samyaktadā satyaṁ vaco 'stu me ।। 7.19.29 ॥

translations.english: O demon, by virtue of my birth in the Ikshvaku lineage, I will speak these words: if I have given charity, offered sacrifices, performed penance well, and protected my subjects properly, then let my words be true.
